final: WITH d AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS t FROM results GROUP BY driverId), o AS (SELECT SUM(t) AS ov FROM d), p AS (SELECT d.driverId, d.t, d.t * 1.0 / o.ov AS ratio FROM d JOIN o ON o.ov IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(t) AS avgt FROM p WHERE t IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT p.t, p.ratio, a.avgt FROM p JOIN a ON a.avgt IS NOT NULL WHERE p.t > a.avgt) SELECT AVG(t) AS avg_kept_total, AVG(ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, AVG(t - avgt) AS avg_kept_diff FROM k
